scope: Solana finalized transaction inclusion and bank-state evidence
issue_fixed: The V3 proof signed a finalized blockhash and bank hash but did not carry a transaction. The verifier therefore could not establish that the value transfer existed in the finalized bank.
implementation: Define SOLANA_FINALIZED_FORMAT_V4 and bind finalized slot, parent slot, blockhash, bank hash, parent bank hash, stake-table digest, transaction slot, index, success status, exact serialized transaction, and transfer intent into one validator-signed message.

Parse the serialized Solana transaction, enforce packet and shortvec bounds, verify its Ed25519 fee-payer signature, and derive its signature, recent blockhash, and domain-separated raw-transaction commitment.
Reject V3 bank-only proof payloads and any V4 payload whose derived transaction fields disagree with the bytes.
Require an RPC-derived transaction on the proof queue path rather than accepting caller-supplied conclusions.
Poll Solana finality with getSlot/getBlock finalized commitment instead of inferring finality from slot age.
Query getTransaction and getBlock with finalized commitment and require the transaction signature, slot, blockhash, index, and successful execution status to agree.
Require at least three distinct Solana RPC endpoints for mainnet and a two-thirds provider quorum reporting identical evidence.
Reject a mainnet relayer configuration with fewer than three distinct non-empty RPC endpoints at startup.
Carry the signed transaction evidence through relayer proof hashing, validator quorum verification, settlement verification, and gateway benchmarks.

verification.command: SKIP_WASM_BUILD=1 CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 cargo clippy -p x3-relayer --all-targets -- -D warnings

negative_and_boundary_tests: A V3 bank-only payload is refused even when its version byte and length are otherwise plausible.
A failed transaction is refused before its votes are counted.
Transaction evidence from a slot other than the finalized slot is refused.
Zero transaction signature, commitment, or recent blockhash identities are refused.
A changed serialized-transaction signature or commitment is refused.
An RPC transaction whose slot, blockhash, signature index, execution status, or serialized signature disagrees with the claim is refused.
A mainnet configuration with fewer than three distinct RPC endpoints is refused before any proof can be produced.
Duplicate or empty RPC endpoints cannot inflate the configured mainnet provider count.
Finality uses the RPC finalized commitment; changing the configured age threshold cannot turn an unfinalized slot into a finalized one.
Provider observations that do not reach the two-thirds agreement threshold are refused.
limitations: No live request was made to Solana devnet or mainnet-beta in this evidence run; the HTTP path is exercised against a local JSON-RPC fixture.
The configured endpoints are required to be distinct URLs, but provider ownership diversity remains an operator attestation.
There is still no production vote-exchange transport for collecting independent validator signatures.
The standalone relayer executable has not yet been replaced by RelayerService.
The settlement-engine SVM submission adapter remains disabled.
